methods.ohlc: open/close = Uniswap v3 slot0 at first block of each hour boundary; high/low include every Swap event price in the hour; volume = |USDG| traded
methods.depth_usd: USDG to move price +2% using active-tick liquidity (ignores tick crossings)
methods.gas_usd: block baseFee x 250000 gas x ETH/USDG pool price; priority fee 0
methods.spread_ratio: 48h median depth / current depth (proxy; not an order-book spread)
methods.regime: SPY daily closes before the tick: vol_shock, gap_news, bull, bear, long_chop (services/ingest/core.mjs)
methods.benchmarks: Yahoo SPY/QQQ hourly; 0 when the exchange is closed
methods.disputed: pool close vs Chainlink-as-of-block deviation > 1% with fresh Chainlink
methods.available_ts: equals tick: historical backfill, not observed live; live ingestion must record real arrival time
